authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan sources, focusing on underetymologised and smaller sources first for greater diversity. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have unlimited time now

proposals.evidence: Turner1296 directly gives Shumashti aratə́ red under ārakta; Buddruss identifies Grangali artə́ with the same arakta family. For Ningalami vartə́, Turner2209 specifically gives uparakta. Buddruss groups the three source forms under arakta generally; the prefixed Ningalami assignment follows Turner’s more specific analysis. Reviewed source audit and import row matched; no transcription or identity changes.

proposals.evidence: Turner11392 directly gives Shumashti wāṣ rain and other Dardic b/waṣ forms. Buddruss Grangali boṣ and Shumashti vas fit this rain family. Turner cautions that some Dardic long-vowel forms could instead continue vārṣa; that historical alternative is retained in the note. Reviewed source audit and import row matched; no transcription or identity changes.

Reviewed source audit and import row matched; no transcription or identity changes.
